model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the percentage of employment rates over time, with the x-axis representing the age of individuals and the y-axis representing the employment rate in percentage. The x-axis ranges from 20 to 70 years, with age intervals of 10 years. The y-axis ranges from 0 to 100%, with intervals of 20%. There are four lines in the plot, each representing a different category. The black line represents individuals without migration background, the grey line represents individuals born in Germany, the light blue line represents individuals who emigrated before 2009, and the dark blue line represents individuals who emigrated since 2010. The black line starts at around 80% employment rate for individuals under 20 years old and gradually decreases to around 20% for individuals over 60 years old. The grey line starts at around 60% employment rate for individuals under 20 years old and fluctuates between 40% and 80% for individuals over 60 years old. The light blue line starts at around 40% employment rate for individuals under 20 years old and fluctuates between 20% and 60% for individuals over 60 years old. The dark blue line starts at around 60% employment rate for individuals under 20 years old and fluctuates between 20% and 60% for individuals over 60 years old. All lines show a general decline in employment rate as age increases, with the black line showing the steepest decline.
